description: Patch schema for local Chatterbox Turbo text-to-speech without a reference audio prompt.

unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_length: The pinned FL_ChatterboxTurboTTS node does not expose a duration control; output length follows text and model prosody.
unmapped_ui_parameters.exaggeration: Turbo exposes temperature, top_k, top_p, and repetition_penalty, not the standard Chatterbox exaggeration control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.speed: Turbo exposes no direct playback-speed control.
unmapped_ui_parameters.remove_silence: The pinned Chatterbox node pack does not expose silence trimming in this node.
unmapped_ui_parameters.audio_ref: Reference audio is handled by the chatterbox_turbo_ref_tts_comfy workflow when a file is supplied.

output.contract: Return one readable FLAC audio artifact generated by the local Chatterbox Turbo TTS node.
